label: Deep refresh across all criteria (25 Nov 2026), including AI-generated works
description: Multi-language sweep across every catalog topic, 25 Nov 2026, plus a dedicated search for AI-generated films, shorts, vertical/micro dramas, YouTube/TikTok/Bilibili/Douyin series, AI anime, and AI comics/webtoons. Focus on titles new since the 17 Nov 2026 deep refresh, plus deeper and older titles not yet found, vertical dramas, and non-English works. Adults only; non-explicit notes; every entry sourced with a confidence label. AI-generated works are marked in format/meta and tagged AI-generated. This file was created at the start of the run and appended at the true end of SOURCES so existing IDs do not shift.

records.title: Lesbian Couple Pregnancy, A Love Story / Deux femmes et un couffin
records.meta: RTS Mise au Point reportage · Switzerland · French · 17 min · first broadcast 1 Sept 2024
records.summary: Official RTS pages follow Sophie and Nathalie, among the first couples of women to marry after Swiss marriage-for-all became law, through fertility treatment at CHUV—including IVF after unsuccessful insemination—to the birth of their son Mika.
records.evidence: The official English RTSpro page (year 2024, production RTS, collection Mise au Point) states Sophie and Nathalie were among the first couple of women to marry after marriage became legal for all, and tells the story of their family project from the ups and downs of in vitro fertilization to the birth of their son. The official French RTSpro page gives the same plot under the title Deux femmes et un couffin. The official RTS news page dated 3 Sept 2024 identifies the same 17-minute Mise au Point reportage (first broadcast 1 Sept 2024), names Sophie and Nathalie Barby, states Sophie carried the child after IVF at CHUV, and names their son Mika.
